author: peaspleasequackquack
body: Avalon Bagels to Burgers. They have two locations, Placentia and Yorba Linda. Don’t forget to try their burgers. It’s so good. Great staff. If you’re a Veteran, they’ll treat you to free food on Veterans Day. My son lost his wallet after getting food there and the owner drove it to our house to return it. Seriously, give it a try if you haven’t.

body: Bagels AND Burgers. That’s cool! Thank you
